continuity.bar_timestamp_convention: UTC bar opens; UTC feature decision closes
continuity.future_bars: bar opens T through T+(H-1)*15 minutes
continuity.missing_features: Exclude incomplete frozen vectors from assignments; report count; do not impute.
continuity.yearly_occupancy_basis: UTC state-assignment year; independent denominators for 2023 and 2024

execution_gate: Contract creation/testing authorizes no validation run or data access; separate authorization and fitted-parameter verification required.

validation_prerequisites: Verify discovery and feature artifact SHA256 before validation access.
Verify immutable discovery-fitted scaler and GMM parameter artifacts and their checksums against discovery provenance.
Preserve scaler mean_/scale_ and GMM weights_/means_/covariances_/precisions_cholesky_ without modification.
Preserve original component indices; no occupancy or outcome-based relabeling.
Record model serialization and library versions in a separate immutable execution manifest before validation access.
If discovery-fitted parameters or their binding are unavailable, stop; do not fit a replacement model in validation.

formulas.cohens_d: (mean_A-mean_B)/pooled sample SD; null if either n<2 or SD=0

H1_MAGNITUDE.expectation: S0 has greater future absolute return than both S1 and S2.
H1_MAGNITUDE.required_effect_sizes: Cohen's d for S0-S1 and S0-S2 at every horizon

H2_VOLATILITY.expectation: S0 has greater future realized volatility than both S1 and S2.
H2_VOLATILITY.required_effect_sizes: Cohen's d for S0-S1 and S0-S2 at every horizon

H3_DIRECTION.expectation: Signed-return separation is much smaller than magnitude/volatility separation; no substantial unconditional directional separation expected.
H3_DIRECTION.ratio_zero_denominator_or_undefined_d: null with reason; never coerce to zero or infinity
H3_DIRECTION.report: Report ratios and whether abs(d_signed) is smaller than each comparator; do not infer materiality or equivalence from a missing prespecified margin.
H3_DIRECTION.required_effect_sizes: Signed-return, absolute-return and realized-volatility Cohen's d for every pair and horizon

pip_normalization: Only explicit reliable symbol pip metadata; otherwise retain price/return units.
price_reference: close of the bar opening at T-15 minutes; feature timestamp T is its decision close

replication_criteria.failed_direction: Either strict inequality does not hold, including a tie or unavailable mean.
replication_criteria.hypothesis_tests: None prescribed; no significance-only success criterion.
replication_criteria.missing_comparison: Count as failed direction; separately flag insufficient evidence, not evidence of reversal.
replication_criteria.overall_report: For each hypothesis: X / 5 horizons replicated; always list all five horizons.
replication_criteria.replicated_direction: Both strict mean inequalities hold at that horizon.

robustness_diagnostics.continuity_exclusions: Reason counts for every state/horizon; include incomplete-feature exclusions separately.
robustness_diagnostics.observations: Observation count for every state/horizon including zero counts.
robustness_diagnostics.occupancy: State counts/fractions over all eligible validation assignments, before future-window exclusions.
robustness_diagnostics.posterior_confidence: Frozen-model maximum posterior: mean, median, p10, p90 overall and per assigned state; no confidence filtering.
robustness_diagnostics.state_transitions: Counts and row-normalized probabilities in S0/S1/S2 order; consecutive exact 15-minute observations with unchanged continuity ID only; empty rows are zero with outgoing count zero.
robustness_diagnostics.use: Report only; never optimization or model-selection inputs.

yearly_occupancy.report: counts and fractions per state independently; empty denominator gives null
